sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Accepted. The candidate uses the canonical namespace and Celsius unit, preserves ship-owned paths, applies the universal essential-engine relationship without requiring engine existence, requires a typed true control value, and enforces a single inclusive Celsius temperature range with decimal quantity values.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Use the canonical Celsius unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG_C in both quantity constraints instead of qudt:DEG_C (the QUDT schema namespace). Preserve the ship-owned paths and range comparison, which otherwise cover the supplied direct-static obligations.

Remove sh:minCount 1 from the ship's nltl:hasEssentialEngine relationship: the requirement is universal over qualifying engines and does not independently require that at least one such engine exists. Preserve the canonical Celsius unit IRI and the ship-owned temperature, control, and inclusive range checks.

Accepted. The candidate uses the canonical namespace and Celsius unit, preserves ship-owned paths, applies the universal essential-engine relationship without requiring engine existence, requires a typed true control value, and enforces a single inclusive Celsius temperature range with decimal quantity values.
